# Tickets

Work items of this repository: epics, stories, tasks and defects, one directory per ticket under this
directory. A ticket says what to do and why; the plans say how, and their checkboxes say how far. Create
tickets with `tickets new`, close them with `tickets close`, and keep this index current with
`tickets write`.
